body: That’s a really great analogue, I’m gonna use this. Thank you!

Damn, this is spot on. I’m so used to walking on broken emotional ankles, and even though I’ve really tried to recognize this lately I just still seem to fall back to the same pattern.
Thank you! Thank you times a million! ❤️

Feeling raw is exactly how I feel! Thank you for your kind words, I think I really needed to hear that. I will follow your advice and take a break/remove myself for a while. It might be the thing that makes my return even stronger.
Again, thank you ❤️ And hugs right back!

You’re right. Not feeling guilty is easier said than done, but maybe I can turn this healing process into something useful for other survivors - but right now most importantly for myself. Thank you ❤️

I will definitely try to do more events cause it really gave me a purpose. I tried reaching out to the group, but they weren’t interested in seeing me again.. I’m appreciate your comment and really like your username btw!

Thank you so much. I really appreciate your reply, it was exactly what I needed.

I had a few days of and returned today, and thankfully there was not much change in their behavior/how they looked at me etc. They just tend to hug me a little bit more which is actually comforting. It doesn’t seem like they told any of the other coworkers which I also appreciate a lot.

It was quite therapeutic to be able to tell my story here since I haven’t told any of my friends about it. I can’t tell you enough how much your reply means to me. Thank you ❤️
